title_seed: Evidence gap 要能驅動補查
central_problem: 當報告缺少某一類 study evidence，系統如何知道該補查什麼，而不是無限重搜？
reader_takeaway: evidence-gap acquisition 要有角色、路由、預算與停止條件。

known_at_the_time.fact: V3 implemented evidence-gap-driven acquisition and formal synthesis path。
current live materialized acceptance was 2/10 LIMITED-or-better and 0/10 FORMAL; frozen replay was 7/10 and 1/10 respectively。

implemented_at_the_time.fact: query/acquisition work was organized around evidence gaps and bounded retries rather than unrestricted Writer reruns。

not_yet_available.fact: five jobs did not materialize into the artifact root before client timeout, so missing downstream counts were UNKNOWN rather than zero。

observed_failures.symptom: several client waits expired before server job artifacts materialized and full text remained sparse
observed_failures.root_cause_if_known: live acquisition completion and materialization were not yet durably observable within the bounded run
observed_failures.what_was_known_then: do not rerun Writer to cover missing evidence
observed_failures.later_resolution: V4 introduced explicit terminal lifecycle and retrieval by job ID

tests_and_metrics.test_or_metric: The current-live V3 cohort reached 2/10 LIMITED-or-better and 0/10 FORMAL; frozen replay separately reached 7/10 and 1/10.
tests_and_metrics.result: live and replay results kept separate

engineering_decisions.decision: 把 evidence gap 變成可執行的 acquisition request，並把 replay 與 current live 結果嚴格分開。

architecture_state.state: accepted studies → evidence-gap matrix → bounded acquisition → Study Facts/synthesis → Writer only if admitted

safe_public_facts.fact: 補查的目標不是讓輸出變長，而是填補一個被明確辨識的 evidence gap。

retrospective_notes.note: V4 會處理 client wait 與 server job 的生命週期；這一日不提前宣稱 V4 已解決。

source_refs.why_it_supports_this_fact: dated V3 live/replay and first weak layer

publication_risks: replay 的 1/10 FORMAL 不可當 live result。
client timeout 不可自動改寫成 job failure。
